Results.ReviewText:
I have been a fan of Weber for a couple of decades and the few I bought back then where and are great grills and are still being cooked on. Concerning the newer innovations that Weber has added, I’m very impressed with the new lid handle design and the clips that keep the legs attached to the bowl. I have an older 18.5 that doesn’t have the leg clips and every time I move it I have to hold the front leg to keep it from falling out of the socket. The lid bail on the back of the kettle is handy instead of the hook inside the lid. As far as performance, the Weber 22.5 kettle can’t be beat with the exception of the 18.5 kettle, which I like better. But for a family of four or more you really need the larger 22.5 to cook on. The new colors the Mastertouch comes in are a nice change. The Spring Green is my favorite and the Ivory is my wife’s. The Ivory with the black handles and black ash pot looks very classy while the Spring Green just pops with color and demands to be paid attention to and used (it’s my favorite).

However I’m not impressed with the quality control. Both the Spring Green and the Ivory upon arrival had issues. The Spring Green had two 2” scratches on the lid down to the metal and the Ivory had a smashed leg from the bowl resting on it and the bowl has some scuff marks from the leg that won’t come off. I contacted customer service and explained the problems, sent pictures of the damage and was promptly sent out the replacements. I commend Weber on their excellent customer service. But then the new lid arrived, no scratches or dings but the vent wheel is so loose and sloppy, I feel like I’m spinning the wheel on that game show that comes on at 6:30 at night. I guess I will pony up and just order a new vent so I can get the proper bolt to mount it back on. 

I ordered an Ivory 18.5 from Germany (as that’s the only place you can pick those up). I hope I don’t have any issues with it as it will be a nightmare to get any fixed. I would still recommend a Weber simply because the customer service is so great and when you get a good one out of the box it will last you forever.
Results.Title: Last two have been a disappointment

Results.ReviewText: After doing extensive research into charcoal grills, I finally pulled the trigger on the mastertouch kettle. I could barely contain my excitement on the drive home to put this bad boy together. As I was putting it together, I was disappointed at the build quality. The legs are one step up from tin foil, they are incredibly flimsy. Once the kettle of flipped right side up, it wobbles as soon as you touch it. Putting the grates in, I noticed that they too wobble. Bending the tabs seemed to help but still not perfect. The center grate of the GBS system also wobbles in its place. Once I put the lid on I discovered my greatest disappointment. The upper on lower bodies are nowhere near circular and do not fit with each other no matter the orientation. After spending near 300 dollars on this bbq, I would have expected better quality. I have not cooked on it yet, so perhaps my eating will go up after I use it for a while. As it stands right now though, I'm pretty disappointed with my brand new webber.

Results.ReviewText:
This is a versatile and affordable product. Mine is used at the cottage where we enjoy entertaining groups of 6-8.  The bbq has enabled me to gain a bit of a reputation for doing this, to the point where I have considered moving up to a more substantial unit. But before I pull the trigger on that, I find myself back at the cottage enjoying another incredible meal from this simple little unit. I think I'll keep the extra $$$ and buy more beef. 

Adjustments to the air intakes at the bottom as well as the exhaust damper at the top allow you to easily control the temperature. The integrated thermometer on this unit is fundamental in this process. You can cook hot and fast or as slow as you wish with this pretty basic bbq. For my skill set, this temperature control allows me to develop recipes with confidence that I can repeat consistently.

Plus, the parts that wear out over time are available from this established brand. I have one that is probably 15 years old because I have been able to replace worn parts.

This is a quality product from a quality company.
